d: The Head of IT will own and execute the technology strategy for a multi‑asset real‑estate services portfolio, covering enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, and core enterprise applications. This role leads architecture, delivery, operations, cybersecurity posture, and vendor/partner management across Azure, SAP, and adjacent ecosystems, ensuring resilient operations, scalable platforms, data integrity, and cost‑effective innovation that directly support property management, leasing, facilities, finance, and customer experience functions.
q: 7–10+ years in enterprise IT with 2–5 years in leadership roles managing infrastructure, cloud, and enterprise apps in real‑estate services or asset‑heavy industries.
Demonstrated, hands‑on expertise with Microsoft Azure (required) : identity (Entra ID), networking, security, governance, landing zones, IaaS/PaaS, automation (ARM/Bicep/Terraform), monitoring.
Proven SAP experience (required) —implementation/upgrade leadership across S/4HANA or key SAP modules (e.g., RE‑FX, Finance, Procurement); familiarity with integrations and data migration.
Experience with AWS and/or Alibaba Cloud (plus), hybrid networking, and multi‑cloud operations.
Experience with Oracle enterprise applications (ERP/HCM/EPM as plus) and common integration frameworks.
Strong track record in IT governance , ITIL , project/program management , vendor management , contracting , and budget ownership .
Solid understanding of cybersecurity frameworks (CIS/NIST/ISO 27001), DR/BCP , and regulatory compliance in the region.
Excellent stakeholder communication and executive reporting; ability to translate technology decisions into business value.
Azure : Entra ID/Azure AD, Virtual Networks, ExpressRoute/VPN, Storage, Key Vault, AKS, App Services, Monitor/Log Analytics, Security Center/Defender, Policy, Cost Management/FinOps.
SAP : S/4HANA architecture, module integration (e.g., RE‑FX/Finance/Procurement), transports, testing, change control, performance optimization.
Integration & Data : API management, iPaaS/ESB, event streaming (Kafka), ETL/ELT, MDM, data governance.
Ops & Automation : IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), APM/observability, ITSM (ServiceNow/Jira), scripting (PowerShell/Python).
Security : IAM, PAM, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, SIEM/SOAR basics, Zero Trust.
AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Security Hub), Alibaba Cloud (ECS, VPC, RAM), Oracle (ERP/EPM).
Salesforce , CAFM/CMMS (e.g., Planon, Archibus), Property/Leasing platforms.
SASE/SD‑WAN , Modern EUC (Intune/Autopilot), S/4HANA Greenfield/Brownfield migration experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering; Master’s preferred.
Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert , Azure Administrator
Security certs (e.g., ISO 27001 Lead Implementer , CISSP , CCSP ) are a plus.
r: Define and maintain the IT strategy, target architecture, and 3‑year roadmap aligned to business growth, regulatory needs, and budget targets.
Establish IT governance , SDLC, DevSecOps, change management, and ITIL service management processes.
Own cloud adoption strategy (Azure required) with multi‑cloud guardrails (AWS/Alibaba Cloud as pluses), landing zones, reference architectures, and policy-as-code.
Partners with Digital, Data, Cybersecurity, and Finance to balance innovation with risk, integrating data governance and FinOps.
Lead end‑to‑end infrastructure operations: networks, data centers, DR/BCP , end‑user compute, identity & access management, and Zero Trust principles.
Design and manage Azure enterprise footprint (IaaS/PaaS), including Azure AD/Entra ID , AKS , Storage , Networking , Backup , and Monitoring .
Oversee multi‑cloud interoperability and connectivity (e.g., AWS VPC, Alibaba Cloud VPC/VSwitch as pluses).
Implement SRE/Observability (APM, logs, metrics, traces) and capacity planning; drive automation (IaC— Terraform/Bicep ), patching, and hardening.
Own the lifecycle of SAP (required)—e.g., S/4HANA , SAP RE-FX , SAP SuccessFactors , SAP Ariba/Fieldglass , SAP Analytics Cloud (as applicable).
Oversee Oracle (as a plus) applications where relevant (EPM, ERP, HCM), ensuring integration patterns and data consistency.
Govern Salesforce/CRM , CAFM/CMMS , Property Management , Leasing , Billing , and Customer Experience platforms in coordination with business owners.
Establish robust integration architecture (ESB/iPaaS, APIs, event streaming) and master data management (MDM) standards.
Partner with CISO/InfoSec to enforce security baselines across cloud, endpoints, network, and applications ; implement CIS/NIST/ISO 27001 controls.
Own DR strategy, RPO/RTO commitments, and cyber incident readiness; ensure compliance with local regulations and data residency requirements.
Embed Privacy-by-Design and secure SDLC across all delivery workstreams.
Lead a blended team of internal staff and strategic partners/SIs , managing SLAs, KPIs, and commercial performance.
Drive program/project delivery for upgrades, migrations, and new capabilities (e.g., SAP S/4HANA transformations, Azure modernization).
Optimize run costs via FinOps , license management , and contract negotiations across Microsoft, SAP, and other enterprise vendors.
Build and mentor high‑performing teams (architecture, platforms, applications, operations).
Promote Agile/DevOps , product mindset, and continuous improvement culture.
Champion a customer‑centric service ethos across all business units and properties.

d: The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technology initiatives. The role requires strong leadership and communication skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and manage project milestones. The individual will be responsible for ensuring high-quality project outcomes are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
The role will primarily focus on cybersecurity projects; therefore, prior experience in managing and delivering cybersecurity initiatives will be considered a strong advantage.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
5+ years of experience managing medium to large IT projects.
Proven track record of successfully delivering projects within scope, on time, and within budget.
Hands-on experience with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello, or similar).
Experience managing cybersecurity projects (e.g., SOC, IAM, GRC, network, endpoint, or data security) is a strong advantage.
Working knowledge of security frameworks and controls (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, or equivalent) is an advantage.
Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or similar Agile certifications.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or CompTIA Security+ are an advantage.
Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Familiarity with system integrations, software development processes, and IT infrastructure.
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
Working understanding of core security domains, including threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, network and endpoint security, and incident response.
Ability to interpret audit findings, risk registers, and remediation plans and translate them into clear project tasks, owners, and deadlines.
Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Arabic and English to effectively liaise with stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional project teams, fostering a collaborative environment.
Skilled in risk analysis, contingency planning, and problem resolution.
Adept at understanding complex business and technical issues and implementing pragmatic solutions.
Proven ability to build rapport with clients, vendors, and team members.
Effective negotiation skills to address conflicting requirements and manage expectations.
Meticulous tracking of project documentation, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
Strong attention to timelines, resources, and quality standards.
r: Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and budget estimation.
Identify project dependencies and manage potential risks and constraints.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication of tasks and responsibilities.
Track project performance against established objectives, milestones, and deliverables.
Implement change management processes to accommodate shifting requirements.
Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve project-related risks and issues.
Develop contingency plans and communicate risk mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
Escalate critical issues to senior management as necessary.

Lead the delivery of cybersecurity initiatives such as security operations, identity and access management, vulnerability and patch management, security tooling rollouts, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) workstreams.
Coordinate with security architects, SOC and infrastructure teams, and specialist vendors to ensure project deliverables align with the organization’s security architecture and control framework.
Track security risks, audit findings, and remediation actions through to closure, ensuring documentation and supporting evidence are maintained for internal and regulatory reviews.
Ensure deliverables comply with applicable security standards and policies (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, and Qatar’s National Information Assurance Policy).
Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the project team.
Prepare and present regular status reports, progress updates, and project dashboards.
Facilitate project meetings, document outcomes, and track action items for follow-up.
Communicate confidently and effectively in Arabic with regional and local stakeholders, ensuring project requirements are clearly understood.
Allocate internal and external resources effectively to optimize productivity.
Manage third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring they meet project standards and deadlines.
Review and approve project-related expenses while adhering to budget constraints.
Define and monitor quality metrics throughout project lifecycles.
Oversee testing and validation processes to ensure project deliverables meet requirements.
Lead post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
Implement best practices in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid).
Advocate continuous improvement to optimize project processes and workflows.
Encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing to enhance team effectiveness.

d: To support GDI’s network infrastructure, secure connectivity services, and communication systems through network administration, connectivity monitoring, security control implementation, and technical support activities to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient network operations in alignment with approved IT and cybersecurity standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline from an internationally recognized university or relevant proven experience.

Minimum of 5 years of total experience in network support, connectivity services, communication systems, and network infrastructure environments within structured IT operations, preferably in the drilling or oil and gas sectors.
Good knowledge of enterprise network environments, routing and switching technologies, WAN/LAN connectivity, wireless networks, VPN services, and network monitoring tools.
Good understanding of network security controls including firewalls, proxy systems, access controls, secure connectivity solutions, infrastructure hardening, and operational cybersecurity practices.
Familiarity with telecommunications services, VSAT connectivity, structured cabling systems, IP telephony, CCTV systems, and communication infrastructure technologies.
Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues, communication failures, infrastructure incidents, and operational service disruptions within enterprise network environments.
Good understanding of preventive maintenance, operational support, infrastructure documentation, and network administration practices.
Effective communication, coordination, vendor management, and stakeholder support skills.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities related to network and communication systems.
Ability to manage multiple operational priorities, support activities, incidents, and maintenance tasks within defined timelines.
Proficiency in network monitoring tools, communication technologies, infrastructure management platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
